desktop.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / compositing. Edit target: the supplied Arena Criolla illustrated cast banner. Recreate this same artwork as a genuinely shallow, ultra-wide panoramic website banner, about 2560 x 288 pixels (roughly 9:1), displayed at only 120–130px high. This is a new composition for the shallow shape, not a crop of the old two-row picture. Preserve the supplied characters' recognizable faces, hair, hats, outfits, illustrated game-art style, and the Caracas sunset / mountain background. Arrange the entire ensemble in one continuous, loosely staggered horizontal row of head-and-shoulder portraits, similar face sizes, with each COMPLETE head, hair and hat inside the image and a little space above every head. Faces should all share a shallow vertical band and remain unobstructed; shoulders may overlap but faces must not. Reduce portrait scale and reposition each character to fit the actual shallow format. Foreground faces cannot sit in a second lower row. Keep the cast visually consistent with the reference rather than inventing different people. Keep calm navy shadows and warm sunset colors matching the game. Draw the full edge-to-edge landscape artwork only. No lettering, logo, frames, borders, mockup, UI elements, letterboxing, or blank padding.
desktop.refinementPrompt: Targeted composition edit to this generated cast panorama. Preserve these exact illustrated characters and their identities, faces, hats, costumes, sunset city and mountain setting. The existing art strip is still too tall. Recreate it as a VERY THIN 11:1 panorama by making each portrait smaller and shallower, showing heads down to collarbones only, in ONE continuous horizontal row. All COMPLETE heads, hair and hats must fit; no clipped foreheads, no faces at the bottom edge, no second row. Make the heads similar-sized and aligned. Practical output layout: a landscape canvas approximately 3072 x 1024 with the ENTIRE finished panorama in one horizontal strip only 280 pixels high centered vertically (about y=372 to y=652); pure white outside this strip is acceptable because the final export will remove that white margin. The actual colored ART STRIP must have width-to-height about 11:1, not 6:1. Scale the figures DOWN enough that no portrait exceeds 210 pixels high within that 280px strip. Keep 24px above the tallest hat and a little space below chins. Fill the whole strip edge-to-edge with the Caracas sunset background. Do not stretch or squash faces. Do not draw decorative borders, text, logos, mockup UI, extra people, or additional scenes. This edit changes the composition proportions only.

tablet.source: The first desktop generation, exported without its exterior white matte. Its wider portrait spacing suits the intermediate 601–1100px layout.

mobile.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / compositing. Edit target: the supplied Arena Criolla mobile cast illustration. Recreate a dedicated compact mobile website banner, landscape 3:1 composition, approximately 1536 x 512 pixels, displayed around 370 x 124 pixels. Recompose for this short shape rather than cropping the current two-row illustration. Use exactly the five FOREGROUND characters from the reference: the bespectacled man in the pale-blue rolled-sleeve shirt with folded arms at far left (Vicente Zavarce), the balding man in a checked blue shirt (Pedro Vallenilla), the cheerful man in the colorful wide striped straw hat and blue floral shirt at center (Er Conde del Guácharo), the older smiling man in the white hat and white formal outfit tipping his hat (Simón Díaz), and the blonde woman in red at far right (Maite Delgado). Preserve each person's recognizable face, expression, hair, hat and clothing with the same illustrated game-art finish. Arrange these five in a SINGLE continuous head-and-shoulders row with aligned eye levels and similar face sizes. Every complete head and hat must be inside the frame, with clear space above and beside it. Shoulders can gently overlap, faces cannot. A little torso can end at the bottom edge. Remove the old back row entirely: no half heads, torsos of hidden people, duplicated characters or extra people. Keep the reference's warm Caracas sunset, palms and mountain silhouettes behind them, with navy shadows so it fits the dark game interface. Full edge-to-edge artwork, no text, logo, frame, mockup, UI, border, letterboxing or blank padding.

export: Remove exterior white matte from the desktop generation, preserve artwork proportions, and encode optimized WebP files. The generated artwork supplies the composition; export must not crop portraits.
